headline: Markets closed in parts of Dhaka on Thursday: Check the list of affected areas
summary: Residents and shoppers in Dhaka should note that several markets and shopping centers will remain closed on Thursday as part of their weekly off-day schedule.
details: Several markets and shopping centers in Dhaka are scheduled to remain closed on Thursday as part of their regular weekly off-day schedule. This routine closure affects various areas across the capital, impacting daily commerce and shopping plans for residents.

The specific list of markets and areas observing this weekly closure is typically announced by local authorities or market associations. Shoppers are advised to verify the operational status of their intended destinations before planning their visits.
